metadata.name: Slack alert investigation
metadata.summary: Investigate every new alert in a Slack channel and post a read-only report in its thread.
metadata.description: Watches one Slack channel. For each new alert it traces the error through your GitHub repository's main branch in a sandbox, optionally checks the alerting Cloudflare Worker's telemetry, and posts a report with code links in the alert's thread. It also posts when it starts and when it fails.
